Subject: DPA, SIG, SOC 2 evidence and SCCs for Atlas Health deal

Hi Mina,

We're preparing to move forward with Redwood for our pilot. Before procurement signs off we need: a customer DPA with SCCs (we're EU/US hybrid), a completed SIG questionnaire (or CAIQ), and the most recent SOC 2 report or a SOC 2 summary of scope and date.

Can you confirm:
- Whether you can accept our standard data retention language (12 months active, 30 days backup) or if that's negotiable
- Whether SCCs are applied by default or require addendum
- Expected timeline to provide a redlined DPA and evidence (SOC 2 summary + SIG)

We're hoping to close contracting this week if possible. Attaching our procurement checklist for reference (see procurement_terms.pdf).

Thanks,
Sana
Sana Patel
Legal Ops, Atlas Health
Attachments: procurement_terms.pdf
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>

Hi Sana — thanks for the note and the checklist. Putting the right folks on this thread.

Quick answers up front:
- SCCs: we can include standard EU SCC addendum; will confirm exact clause set in the redline.
- Retention: 12 months active / 30 days backup is within our default range for pilot workloads, but we'll need to confirm any special PHI/HIPAA constraints (see below).
- SOC 2: I can share the SOC 2 summary and our last certification date — attaching SOC2-summary.pdf.

Next steps: I'll send our standard DPA and flag the places Rishi/legal will likely propose small edits. Laura will confirm privacy/DPIA implications for EU data and any SCC specifics. Marcus from finance will handle signature routing/DocuSign.

Attaching: Redwood_DPA_Standard_v2026-06.docx (first pass) and SOC2-summary.pdf.

Best,
Mina Haddad

Thanks Mina / Sana — quick read through:
- I'm attaching a redline (DPA_Redline_v1.docx) with two substantive asks from Atlas that we'll likely counter: (1) retention limits language — propose clarifying \"business need\" carve outs; (2) indemnity caps tied to aggregate fees — propose mutual liability cap where possible.
- SCCs: we'll attach our standard SCC Annex (EU Addendum) to the DPA; Laura, please confirm if the Annex we use covers both Controller/Processor scenarios.
- SOC 2: the summary covers scope (data processed, subservice providers) and last audit date (2026-03). We'll provide the full report under NDA if Atlas needs it.

Action items for Atlas: please confirm whether your retention numbers are tied to regulated medical records policy (HIPAA) or internal retention only — that changes the approach.

I'll be out Thursday morning but otherwise available for a quick call.

Regards,

From: Evan Brooks <evan.brooks@atlashealth.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 28 Jul 2026 11:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: DPA, SIG, SOC 2 evidence and SCCs for Atlas Health deal

Thanks — a couple of clarifications from procurement's side:
- Retention: the 12 months active / 30-day backup is Atlas' standard for pilot PHI datasets. We will not be able to accept broad "business need" carveouts that permit retention beyond 12 months unless an explicit justification is documented and approved by our privacy team.
- SCCs: we need confirmation that the SCC Annex will be executed and that it covers onward transfers to subprocessors in the US.
- Signature: prefer DocuSign, and please route first to our counterparty contact (Sana) then to Procurement Director (procurement@atlashealth.com).

Attached our procurement terms page for retention and subprocessors (procurement_terms.pdf). Looking forward to Rishi's redline.

Best,
Evan Brooks
Senior Procurement Manager — Atlas Health
Attachments: procurement_terms.pdf
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>

Hi all — quick privacy note:
- DPIA: because Atlas is processing health data (PHI), we should run a scoped DPIA. For the pilot, capture intended data categories and retention justification; I can draft a short DPIA addendum for the DPA.
- SCCs: our standard SCC Annex covers controller->processor and includes clauses for subprocessors and onward transfers; we will attach it.
- SIG/CAIQ: attached is a completed SIG questionnaire (SIG-completed.xlsx) with evidence links called out. If Atlas needs deeper tech artifacts, we can provide SOC 2 backup under NDA (SOC2-summary.pdf already shared).

I think we can accept the 12/30 retention for the pilot contingent on DPIA and an agreed data flow diagram. Rishi — happy to coordinate the DPIA language.

Thanks,
Laura Bennett
Privacy Counsel

1) DPA redline: Rishi has sent DPA_Redline_v1.docx with our proposed counters on retention carveouts and liability. Please review and flag urgent items; we'll aim to turn a final redline within 48 hours.
2) SCCs: we'll include our standard EU SCC Annex with the DPA. Laura confirmed it covers subprocessors/onward transfers.
3) SIG & SOC 2: SIG-completed.xlsx attached — if you want the full SOC 2 report we'll provide under NDA; SOC2-summary.pdf included earlier for immediate review.

5) Signature routing: Marcus (cc'd) will route the final DPA via DocuSign to Sana and then procurement@atlashealth.com.
